thesis: One account, one coin, one rail. Rei (XR) is the prime coin. American Perpetual is the regulated rail that lists perpetuals on everything through MIAX and OCC. Every earlier idea is a pod pushing the same X toward infinity.
abstract: Every crypto idea Saheb has written down since 2021, read in full and unified: the main coin over product coins, the fund that wanted to be a bank, the exchange where the house earns the fees, and where they land in October 2026 — Rei (零 · XR), a coin whose supply steps up the primes, and American Perpetual, a licence to 60% of MIAX's fees on every perpetual product.
